mapper.select: SELECT l.log_number, l.user_number, u.user_nickname, l.log_title, l.log_post, l.log_date, l.log_modify_date, ( SELECT li.log_img_path FROM ddd_log_img li WHERE li.log_number = l.log_number AND li.log_img_number = ( SELECT MIN(li2.log_img_number) FROM ddd_log_img li2 WHERE li2.log_number = l.log_number ) ) AS representative_img_path FROM ddd_log l JOIN ddd_user u ON l.user_number = u.user_number ORDER BY l.log_date DESC
SELECT l.log_number, l.user_number, l.log_title, l.log_post, l.log_date, l.log_modify_date FROM ddd_log l WHERE l.log_number = #{value}

SELECT l.log_number, l.user_number, u.user_nickname, l.log_title, l.log_post, l.log_date, l.log_modify_date FROM ddd_log l JOIN ddd_user u ON l.user_number = u.user_number WHERE l.log_number = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ddd_log ( user_number, log_title, log_post, log_date, log_modify_date ) VALUES ( #{userNumber}, #{logTitle}, #{logPost}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ddd_log SET log_title = #{logTitle}, log_post = #{logPost}, log_modify_date = NOW() WHERE log_number = #{logNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT l.log_number, l.user_number, u.user_nickname, l.log_title, l.log_post, l.log_date, l.log_modify_date, ( SELECT li.log_img_path FROM ddd_log_img li WHERE li.log_number = l.log_number AND li.log_img_number = ( SELECT MIN(li2.log_img_number) FROM ddd_log_img li2 WHERE li2.log_number = l.log_number ) ) AS representative_img_path FROM ddd_log l JOIN ddd_user u ON l.user_number = u.user_number WHERE l.log_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') ORDER BY l.log_date DESC

SELECT l.log_number, l.user_number, u.user_nickname, l.log_title, l.log_post, l.log_date, l.log_modify_date, ( SELECT li.log_img_path FROM ddd_log_img li WHERE li.log_number = l.log_number AND li.log_img_number = ( SELECT MIN(li2.log_img_number) FROM ddd_log_img li2 WHERE li2.log_number = l.log_number ) ) AS representative_img_path FROM ddd_log l JOIN ddd_user u ON l.user_number = u.user_number WHERE u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR u.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') ORDER BY l.log_date DESC

SELECT c.comment_number, c.log_number, c.user_number, u.user_nickname, c.comment_post, c.comment_date FROM ddd_log_comment c JOIN ddd_user u ON c.user_number = u.user_number WHERE c.log_number = #{value} ORDER BY c.comment_date ASC
SELECT comment_number, log_number, user_number, comment_post, comment_date FROM ddd_log_comment WHERE comment_number = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ddd_log_comment ( log_number, user_number, comment_post, comment_date ) VALUES ( #{logNumber}, #{userNumber}, #{commentPost}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT log_img_number, log_number, log_img_name, log_img_path FROM ddd_log_img WHERE log_number = #{value} ORDER BY log_img_number ASC

SELECT log_img_number, log_number, log_img_name, log_img_path FROM ddd_log_img WHERE log_number = #{value} AND log_img_number = ( SELECT MIN(log_img_number) FROM ddd_log_img WHERE log_number = #{value} )
